latest.notes:
Records what the audio engine does at each hand-off, to catch the intermittent late start.

• Diagnostic only — nothing about playback changes. Each transition now logs the timing the engine used, and how far into an element it already was at the moment it became audible. That second number is what you hear: zero is correct, anything else is how much of the start was missed.
• A bad one is logged as an error saying the start of the element was not heard, so it can be found after the fact instead of reconstructed from memory.

To read it:
  /usr/bin/log show --predicate 'subsystem == "com.skyrocketradio.AvvioOne"' --last 2h --debug --info --style compact | grep handoff

Includes v0.5.86: play a commercial from its row in Traffic.
